_comment: WS4 centerM sweep — small-M + small-S + centerM>1 hypothesis. centerM is now the outer-mass multiplier (total simulated mass / inner observable mass); particles scale linearly so centerM=3 adds ~2x more outer particles at same density. Selection by minimum chi2/dof vs Pantheon+. chi2_lcdm~0.436 / chi2_eds~0.843 are reference benchmarks only, NOT the selection target. NOTE: _generate_ws4_figs.py runs the small-M hypothesis corner only (it filters M_values to M<=20 for runtime); M_values below is set to exactly that grid so this committed config matches what the default driver produces. A fuller sweep INCLUDING the M~50/S~20 corner (the model's known near-LCDM band, see lode PF4/PF6) is a documented open follow-up — to run it, raise M_values here AND remove the M<=20 filter in _generate_ws4_figs.py (or drive sweep.py directly with this config).
